internal_stability.method: Whole-specimen curve through (0.005 mm, clay), (0.075 mm, fines), d10, d20, d30, d50, d60, (2 mm, 100 - gravel), (dmax, 100), log-linear (item 4's reconstruction). H(D) = F(4D) - F(D); (H/F)min over D with F(D) <= 20 % (widely graded; all 28 have Uc > 3) and <= 30 %. The upper bound uses, at each D, the largest F(4D) and smallest F(D) any monotone curve through the tabulated points allows.
